title: Graffiti Punk Girl
description: A fierce female character with voluminous bright red hair stands in a dynamic pose, holding a spray can emitting a vibrant purple energy beam from its nozzle. She wears a red crop top, red shorts, red platform boots, and has dramatic makeup with an open-mouthed expression.
prompt: A dynamic full-body illustration of a punk rock girl with massive flowing bright red hair, wearing a red leather crop top, red shorts, red platform boots, and gold accessories. She holds a spray paint can that is shooting a glowing purple energy beam upwards. She has dramatic blue eyeshadow, an open mouth shouting expression, and stands in an aggressive wide stance against a plain gray background.
